native_fixture_integrity.method: Compare all native entry fields, notes/forms/senses/examples and English equivalents to hashed pinned LMF exports; omit RelatedForm and non-English equivalents.

raw_comparison.interpretation: New grammar hypotheses are retained; only explicit ledger matches are judged. Unjudged candidates are not certified correct.

corpus_interpretation: All four frozen reports are byte-identical. Their marker hits cross lexical/adverbial base + 까지 boundaries and are not annotated question tokens. All six pinned files have zero annotated 리까 endings among the ten substring hits audited separately. This proves preservation, not independent validation of the new ending. Direct primary examples remain source tokens, not invented corpus gold.
